entries.title: Psalms 59:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. 'Destroy not.' Of David. Michtam; when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.>> Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God; secure me on high from them that rise up against me.

entries.title: Psalms 59:2
segments: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from men of blood.

entries.title: Psalms 59:3
segments: For behold, they lie in wait for my soul; strong ones are gathered against me: not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 59:4
segments: They run and prepare themselves without [my] fault: awake to meet me, and behold.

entries.title: Psalms 59:5
segments: Yea, do thou, Jehovah, the God of hosts, the God of Israel, arise to visit all the nations: be not gracious to any plotters of iniquity. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 59:6
segments: They return in the evening; they howl like a dog, and go round about the city:

entries.title: Psalms 59:7
segments: Behold, they belch out with their mouth; swords are in their lips: for who [say they] doth hear?

entries.title: Psalms 59:8
segments: ¶But thou, Jehovah, wilt laugh at them; thou wilt have all the nations in derision.

entries.title: Psalms 59:9
segments: Their strength! ...I will take heed to thee; for God is my high fortress.

entries.title: Psalms 59:10
segments: God, whose loving-kindness will come to meet me, --God shall let me see [my desire] upon mine enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 59:11
segments: Slay them not, lest my people forget; by thy power make them wander, and bring them down, O Lord, our shield.

entries.title: Psalms 59:12
segments: [Because of] the sin of their mouth, the word of their lips, let them even be taken in their pride; and because of cursing and lying which they speak.

entries.title: Psalms 59:13
segments: Make an end in wrath, make an end, that they may be no more; that they may know that God ruleth in Jacob, unto the ends of the earth. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 59:14
segments: And in the evening they shall return, they shall howl like a dog, and go round about the city.

entries.title: Psalms 59:15
segments: They shall wander about for meat, and stay all night if they be not satisfied.

entries.title: Psalms 59:16
segments: But as for me, I will sing of thy strength; yea, I will sing aloud of thy loving-kindness in the morning; for thou hast been to me a high fortress, and a refuge in the day of my trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 59:17
segments: Unto thee, my strength, will I sing psalms; for God is my high fortress, the God of my mercy.
